import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int MAXN = 505;
    static long[] fact = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] inv_fact = new long[MAXN];
    static long[][] dpF = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] dpG = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[] f_arr = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] g_arr = new long[MAXN];
    static int n, m, P, maxn;

    static long mod_pow(long base, int exp) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = res * base % P;
            base = base * base % P;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long comb(int x, int y) {
        if (x < y || y < 0) return 0;
        return fact[x] * inv_fact[y] % P * inv_fact[x - y] % P;
    }

    static int sum_series(int x) {
        return x * (x + 1) / 2;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        P = sc.nextInt();
        maxn = n + 1;

        fact[0] = 1;
        inv_fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxn; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % P;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxn; i++) {
            inv_fact[i] = mod_pow(fact[i], P - 2);
        }

        f_arr[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                f_arr[i] = (f_arr[i] + f_arr[j] * f_arr[i - 1 - j] % P * comb(i - 1, j)) % P;
                g_arr[i] = (g_arr[i] + (((g_arr[j] * f_arr[i - 1 - j]) % P + (f_arr[j] * g_arr[i - 1 - j]) % P) * (i + 1) % P
                        + f_arr[j] * f_arr[i - 1 - j] % P * (sum_series(j) + sum_series(i - 1 - j))) % P * comb(i - 1, j)) % P;
            }
            f_arr[i] = f_arr[i] * (i + 1) % P;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                dpF[i][j] = 0;
                dpG[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        dpF[0][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            dpF[0][j] = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            dpF[i][i] = f_arr[i];
            dpG[i][i] = g_arr[i];
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= n; j++) {
                dpF[i][j] = dpF[i][j - 1];
                dpG[i][j] = dpG[i][j - 1];
                for (int l = 1; l <= i; l++) {
                    long tempF = (dpF[i - l][j - 1 - l] * f_arr[l]) % P * comb(i, l) % P;
                    long tempG = ((dpG[i - l][j - 1 - l] * f_arr[l]) % P + (dpF[i - l][j - 1 - l] * g_arr[l]) % P) * comb(i, l) % P;
                    dpF[i][j] = (dpF[i][j] + tempF) % P;
                    dpG[i][j] = (dpG[i][j] + tempG) % P;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dpG[m][n]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
